name: Knatware LLM Chain — Open-Source Model Inference (Hugging Face)

parameters.content:
## Knatware LLM Chain — Open-Source Model Inference
A minimal chat workflow that sends your message to an **open-source model hosted on Hugging Face** via the free Hugging Face Inference API — no local GPU required.

### How it works
1. **When chat message received** — n8n's built-in chat UI captures your message.
2. **Basic LLM Chain** — forwards it to the connected model.
3. **Hugging Face Inference Model** — runs the open-source model on Hugging Face's servers and returns the reply.

Click **Chat** at the bottom of the canvas (after activating this workflow) to talk to it.

### Changing the model
Open the **Hugging Face Inference Model** node and edit the **Model** field to any Hugging Face repo id (e.g. `Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct`, `mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3`, `meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct`, `HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-beta`) — no other changes needed.

## Hugging Face Setup
1. Get a free token: https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens (Read access is enough for public models).
2. In the **Hugging Face Inference Model** node below, click **Credential to connect with > Create new credential**, and paste the token.
3. Set the **Model** field to any Hugging Face repo id you have inference access to. Smaller instruct models (1B-8B) respond fastest on the free tier.
4. Gated models (e.g. Llama, Gemma) require accepting the license on the model's Hugging Face page first, with a token that has access.

messageValues.message: You are a helpful assistant running on a free, open-source language model hosted on Hugging Face. Answer clearly and concisely.
